definitions.gloss: while humming; humming along; humming cheerfully
definitions.explanation: Doing something while humming a tune, typically conveying a relaxed, cheerful, or carefree mood.

examples.japanese: {鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To cook while humming a tune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}していた→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: She was hanging up the laundry while humming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧になっている。
examples.english: On nice mornings, it's my daily routine to take a walk while humming.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{鼻歌|はなうた}→鼻歌：18017_hanauta⟧ (humming, singing through the nose) and まじり (mixed with, accompanied by). Describes doing an activity while casually humming, implying the person is in a good mood or at ease.

The expression paints a vivid picture of someone going about their daily tasks in a light, carefree manner. It often appears in literary descriptions and everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk while humming
- {鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work while humming
- {鼻歌|はなうた}まじり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean while humming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻歌|はなうた}→鼻歌：18017_hanauta⟧: humming — the act of humming itself
- ⟦{上機嫌|じょうきげん}→上機嫌：24293_joukigen⟧: in a good mood — describes the mood without the humming
- {楽|たの}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: looking happy, cheerfully — a general descriptor of cheerful behavior
